fields.name: Gubera Saree
fields.description:
Experience elegance and comfort with our beautifully crafted Gubera Saree, designed for women who love traditional charm with a modern touch. Made from soft, lightweight fabric, this saree drapes effortlessly and is perfect for daily wear, office, small functions, and gifting.

✨ Features:

Soft and comfortable fabric

Lightweight & easy to drape

Beautiful woven patterns

Ideal for daily wear and festive occasions

Perfect gift for loved ones

🎁 What You Get:
1 Gubera Saree (Unstitched blouse included)

A stylish saree at an affordable price — perfect for all ages!
